trial_title: IVIG Versus Placebo for the Treatment of Patients With Severe C-Diff
brief_summary:
In this trial, eligible patients will be randomly assigned to receive a single dose of 400 mg/kg of IVIG or a normal saline infusion as placebo over 4-6 hours, in addition to their usual medications for CDAD. We expect to enroll approximately 40 patients over a period of two years from UPMC Shadyside Hospital, McKeesport Hospital, and St. Margaret's Hospital who are unresponsive to standard antimicrobial therapy for CDAD.

eligibility_table.criterion: Males and female greater than 18 years of age
Positive stool C. difficile cytotoxin assay and/or biopsy evidence of Pseudomembranous Colitis (PMC) at onset of illness
eligibility_table.justification: No stool C. difficile cytotoxin assay or biopsy evidence provided in the profile.
eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a positive stool C. difficile cytotoxin assay or biopsy evidence of Pseudomembranous Colitis (PMC) at the onset of illness?

eligibility_table.criterion: Current history of severe, relapsing CDAD or Current history of severe, refractory CDAD
eligibility_table.justification: Patient has a current history of severe, relapsing C. difficile infection.

eligibility_table.criterion: A score of 6 or 7 on the C.Diff Severity and Prognosis Score (CDSPS) scale OR failure to respond (as identified by a score of 4 or more on the CDSPS scale below) to any of the following: a 4-day or more course of oral or IV metronidazole 500 mg po TID or QID; or to a 4-day course of oral vancomycin 125-500 mg po Q6 hours; or to a 4-day course of vancomycin enemas; or failure to respond to a 4-day course of combination therapy of oral vancomycin 125-500 mg po Q6 hours and IV metronidazole 500mg IV Q8 or Q6 hours and/or vancomycin enemas.
eligibility_table.justification: Patient has failed prior antibiotic treatments for C. difficile, indicating a score of 4 or more on the CDSPS scale.

eligibility_table.criterion: CDSPS SCALE (each item is scored as one point for a 7 point maximum total)

eligibility_table.clinical_question: Does the patient have a CDSPS score of ≤3?

eligibility_table.justification: Patient has End Stage Renal Disease (ESRD), which is a chronic medical condition.
